[[File:Xizor-SOTETPB.png|thumb|right|200px|Xizor, the Dark Prince]]
'''Dark Prince''' was a title used in reference to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] during his reign as [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], where he was known as "[[Underlord]]."

==Appearances==
*[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire Galoob minicomic|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' Galoob minicomic]]
*[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] {{1st|in book}}
*[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (abridged audiobook)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' abridged audiobook]]
*[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' junior novelization]]
*[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire Ertl minicomic|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' Ertl minicomic]]
